description: The folders cyfr setup hands the CYFR app as --setup-project, per system (Go's GOOS). taken are forms the system calls absolute (filepath.IsAbs), which filepath.Abs can answer for a working directory and the app suggests as they are; refused are forms the app refuses, each relative or holding a . or .. after its volume, which filepath.Abs never answers. On Windows a volume is a drive's letter and a colon, or a network share's two backslashes, server and share (\\?\ and \\.\ among them), and absolute is a volume followed by a backslash, or a share alone. Read by cmd/setup_test.go on its own system and by the app's policy test on all three.
